userActions: Approve the npm-publish environment for the dispatched Release workflow; the publish job then runs the verified tarball through OIDC and creates the v0.4.0 tag/Release.
Update from Plugins once 0.4.0 is on npm (the Versions section appears for npm installs), then refresh the page once.
Open any plugin's detail page: it is now the preview banner instead of the README text.
